mapper.insert: insert into group_buy (group_no, initiator_id, status, required_count, current_count, expire_at, created_at, updated_at) values (#{groupNo}, #{initiatorId}, #{status}, #{requiredCount}, #{currentCount}, #{expireAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update:
update group_buy
initiator_id = #{initiatorId},
status = #{status},
required_count = #{requiredCount},
current_count = #{currentCount},
expire_at = #{expireAt},
updated_at = #{updatedAt},
where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select * from group_buy where status = 1 and expire_at < #{now} order by expire_at asc
select gb.* from group_buy gb inner join group_buy_participant gbp on gb.id = gbp.group_buy_id where gbp.member_id = #{memberId} order by gb.created_at desc
